# Results summary (auto-generated by experiments/analyze.py)

## E1/E2: interventions (n=2 unless noted, 100 seeds each)

`delta`: collusion index, mean [95% bootstrap CI]; 0 = static Nash, 1 = monopoly. `bits`: information about each rival price the agent can observe (uniform prior). `dCS`/`dW`: change in consumer surplus / total welfare vs. baseline. `punish`: rival's price response one period after a forced deviation (units of p_M - p_N; negative = punishment). `dev_gain`: discounted gain from the deviation (units of pi_M - pi_N; negative = deviation unprofitable).

## E3: does collusion survive swapping an agent? (100 sessions)

| condition                                               | delta             |   punish |   dev_gain | share_delta_gt_half   |
|:--------------------------------------------------------|:------------------|---------:|-----------:|:----------------------|
| original pair (no swap)                                 | 0.81 [0.79, 0.83] |   -0.412 |     -1.343 | 99%                   |
| cross-play: partner from another session, no relearning | 0.20 [0.17, 0.23] |   -0.004 |      0.042 | 4%                    |
| fresh Q-learner replaces firm 1, both keep learning     | 0.74 [0.72, 0.76] |   -0.336 |     -0.857 | 97%                   |
| fresh Q-learner vs. frozen incumbent                    | 0.62 [0.59, 0.65] |   -0.102 |      1.536 | 77%                   |
| myopic (gamma=0) learner replaces firm 1                | 0.42 [0.38, 0.46] |   -0.175 |     -1.391 | 34%                   |
